hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qiE '(rm -rf|git push --force|git reset --hard|git clean)'; then echo 'BLOCK: Destructive command requires explicit user approval' >&2; exit 1; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qiE '(\.env|\.env\.local|\.pem$|\.key$|secrets\.json|credentials\.json)'; then echo 'BLOCK: Cannot modify secrets/env files' >&2; exit 1; fi
